title: Woman trips over while trying to stop a cat from entering home
description:
The clip features a woman who just walked in from a long day and found her doorway hosting an uninvited furry guest.

The outside cat clearly had VIP energy, refusing to respect boundaries, and was dead set on entering like it owned the place.

As the door swung open, it made a sneaky move and slid in with her.

She tried every trick in the book to keep it out, but fate had other ideas.

She tripped, fell, and the cat claimed victory.

Sometimes the universe just ships cats and chaos together.
